seo.title: Creative glossary — impulse, mirror, Thread, BYOK | Pastek Art
seo.description: Fifteen terms to understand Pastek Art: impulse, starter, ritual, brief, creative mirror, Thread, BYOK, express and deep modes, seasons, local-first.

hero.title: Words that
hero.lead: A short glossary — technical and creative — naming what Pastek Art offers: impulse, ritual, mirror, Thread, and a few useful ideas before you make.

cta.label: Start creating
cta.a11y: Open the Pastek Art creative space

impulse.body: The starting point of the ritual: a word, a colour, a sensation, an inner image. In Pastek Art, the impulse is not a marketing brief — it is what calls the gesture before technique even enters.

amorce.body: A light path to bring forth an impulse: word Ping-Pong, palette, emotion explorer, Three gestures, One rule… The starter precedes making; it does not replace it.

ritual.body: Pastek Art’s guided journey: impulse → technique and length → brief → making time → capture and mirror. A gentle frame, not an endless chat with the AI.

brief.body: The invitation that helps you begin — short, open, without judgement. It opens the gesture; you remain free to drift from it. A development paragraph may clarify the flow without freezing the outcome.

mirror.body: The kind reflection after making. It welcomes what is there (colours, gesture, text) in the conditional mood — no clinical diagnosis, no art critique. Optional, and often most useful when kept short.

fil.body: The local memory of your practice: ritual and starter traces, photos, tags. Opt-in, on this device. The Thread can feed a longer mirror if you choose — without uploading your work by default.

byok.body: You can plug in your own AI key (Mistral, OpenAI, and more). The key stays on the device; Pastek Art does not store it on the server. Without a key, local paths and fallback modes remain available.

express.body: The short rhythm of the ritual: generate, make, welcome the reflection without extra grounding steps. Ideal when time is tight and momentum matters more than a guided arc.

deep.body: A slower journey: grounding questions before the mirror, then integration prompts to close the session. Same studio, different breath — without turning Pastek into a therapy tool.

season.body: A gentle habit over 7 to 14 days: a simple constraint (colour, format, technique) returns in the brief, without a punitive streak. The season supports rhythm; it does not judge attendance.

guided-exercise.body: An invitation to make within a clear frame (length, technique, impulse) and room for silence. The aim is not a “successful” artwork: it is exploring the process — drawing, painting, collage, writing, gesture…

bespoke.body: Compose a session by choosing theme, emotion, intention and technique, then let the exercise emerge. Another doorway when a free impulse does not arrive on its own.

local-first.body: Your traces, preferences and keys stay on the device first. No login wall to create. Cloud sync, when available, stays optional and serves backup.

letting-go.body: Accepting that the gesture may leave the brief, that a mark counts, that there is no right result to chase. Pastek Art puts this posture at the centre: curiosity before mastery, presence before performance.

creative-silence.body: During the exercise, the screen can step back so only the timer and the gesture remain. Silence is not productive emptiness: it is the time when material, not the interface, leads.
